revisions.description: Switched the xAI plugin auth source from OpenCode's `xai` OAuth entry (`~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json`) to GrokBuild's `~/.grok/auth.json`: scan all entries and use the first object with a non-empty `key`, expire via `expires_at` (ISO) with JWT `exp` fallback, and identify billing requests with the `X-XAI-Token-Auth: xai-grok-cli` header.
revisions.reason: The user runs GrokBuild (not OpenCode) for xAI auth; GrokBuild owns the `~/.grok/auth.json` store and its refresh flow, so Tuxmeter must read it read-only and never write tokens or call OAuth endpoints.
revisions.author: AI

revisions.description: Added xAI period duration to progress output so pace status indicators and in-bar time markers render when billing boundaries are available.
revisions.reason: The initial plugin exposed the reset timestamp but omitted the period length required by Tuxmeter's pace calculation.
revisions.author: AI
